transcript.content: I forgot to add my company GSTIN when ordering. Can you add it to the invoice now?

Unfortunately, we cannot add a GSTIN to an invoice after the order has been placed. Once an invoice is generated, it is sent to the GST portal and cannot be modified. To ensure your GSTIN is included, please add it at the time of checkout during the ordering process. For bulk or corporate orders, you can email [email withheld] with your details for a quote. I'm here to help with anything else!
